json.notes: Musée d'Orsay is a long stone station building along the Seine (front at -z). It has a big barrel-vaulted nave roof running along x behind the front, and a stone front with large arched openings and a central clock pavilion. The ends have taller pavilions with steep slate roofs and a small domed cupola. The west end (left, -x) is a hotel-style block with a mansard roof and a glass canopy at the forecourt. I model the stone body, the vault, the clock pavilion, the end pavilions and the front canopy.
